messages:
maria: Heads up — customer reported being billed twice on a single streaming + toolcall flow. They reconnect after a short network blip and we show two provisional charges.
jon: repro steps?
maria: 1) start streaming session, 2) call tool (toolcall id tc-910) which times out TTL-wise, 3) client reconnects and resumes, 4) console shows two provisional entries.
kevin: is the second charge from a resumed prefix being re-attributed as a fresh token batch?
sam: might be our provisional ledger not deduping resume events when toolcall TTL was hit. we do provisional charge at toolcall ack + at stream resume if offset unknown.
maria: attaching a short log snip from the customer's trace: ```
[INFO] 2026-03-20T12:00:59Z req=abc123 session=ssd-77 toolcall=tc-910 action=toolcall_timeout ttl_expired=true
[INFO] 2026-03-20T12:01:01Z req=abc124 session=ssd-77 reconnect=1 resume_hint=unknown
[billing] provisional_charge session=ssd-77 amount=0.003 token_units=120 id=prov-789
[billing] provisional_charge session=ssd-77 amount=0.003 token_units=120 id=prov-790
```
jon: ugh. Two provisional ids. Why didn't the resume detect prov-789 and ack it instead of creating prov-790?
kevin: current resume idempotency keys are per-request. If the toolcall TTL is hit, the server clears the last-ack pointer and resumes create a new provisional.
maria: customer says they never retried the toolcall, only reconnected the stream.
sam: confirm: when TTL->toolcall expired we garbage the toolcall anchor. reconnect comes in with no anchor -> we treat it as a new append.
jon: can we change resume logic to prefer recent provisional charges for same session+client_ip within a 2s window?
kevin: risk: that heuristic could hide legitimate separate requests (client did intentionally replay). We need stronger signal.
sam: proposal: add resume_hint metadata on reconnect if client supplies last_toolcall_id. internal API change: `resume_hint: { last_toolcall: "tc-910", last_offset: 12345 }`. If present, server will try to reattach and reuse provisional.
maria: is client change realistic? some customers won't update quickly.
jon: fallback: better console UX — surface 'provisional duplicates' and allow ops to mark one as duplicate (which would collapse charges). short-term mitigation.
billing-bot: Alert: created provisional charges prov-789, prov-790 for session ssd-77. Suspected resume-dup.
kevin: longer-term: instrument telemetry tag `resume.v2` and batch recons for a day to measure FP rate before changing billing. We need thresholds: <=0.5% false dedupe acceptable.
sam: plan: 1) add telemetry tag & metric for resume-provisional-dup (2 days), 2) add console filter "Show provisional duplicates" behind feature flag, 3) pilot resume_hint API with internal customers.
maria: can someone draft the console copy? Ops want clear language: "Two provisional charges observed — likely duplicate from reconnect. Click to collapse"
jon: I'll draft. Also add a small canary rollout for 10% of requests to treat reconnects with recent provisional as reattach (not final charge) and emit metric.
kevin: make sure reserved capacity billing still applies — do not delay final charge for reserved customers (we must honor capacity commit). Tagging: `billing.policy=reserved_override`.
sam: created a quick CLI debug snippet to repro locally: ```bash
# simulate toolcall TTL then reconnect
./simulate_stream --session ssd-77 --toolcall tc-910 --toolcall-ttl 1500ms \\n  && sleep 0.5 \\n  && ./simulate_reconnect --session ssd-77 --resume_hint last_toolcall=tc-910
```
maria: thanks. next: can we get an eng-platform owner for the telemetry/console work?
jon: i'll own console copy + feature flag. sam will own server resume_hint. kevin will own billing policy guardrails and telemetry aggregation.
maria: great. leaving notes for support: add KB entry explaining provisional duplicates and how to collapse in console.
jon: note for rollout: metrics to watch: `provisional_dup_rate`, `collapsed_by_ops`, `replay_false_positive_rate`.
kevin: timeline? sam: telemetry + console flag in 48h, resume_hint pilot next week.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
